name: Utopia
source:
Summer vacation.
While Mayu's parents went on a trip for their wedding anniversary, she stayed home alone. Though she felt like she couldn't be bothered to, she went grocery shopping and when she came back home, there was a strange boy in her house. He introduced himself as Lucia and said he was an angel. Although she found it unbelievable, she was somehow persuaded to start living with Lucia.

[Translated from [url=http://thunders.silk.to/game/utopia/story_system.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，Mayu的父母为了庆祝结婚纪念日出门旅行，她独自留在家里。虽然觉得出门买菜很麻烦，她还是去了。回到家时，却发现屋里多了一个奇怪的男孩。他自称Lucia，说自己是天使。尽管Mayu觉得难以置信，却不知为何还是被说服，开始和Lucia一起生活。

[译自[url=http://thunders.silk.to/game/utopia/story_system.htm]官方网站[/url]]
